en: Job 21

p.src: 1  Then Job answered,

en: Then Job answered,
u.src: 1  Then Job answered,

p.src: 2  “Listen diligently to my speech. Let this be your consolation.

ja: に注意深く耳を傾けよ。 これをあなたがたの
en: “Listen diligently to my speech. Let this be your consolation.
u.src: 2  “Listen diligently to my speech. Let this be your consolation.

p.src: 3  Allow me, and I also will speak. After I have spoken, mock on.

en: Allow me, and I also will speak. After I have spoken, mock on.
u.src: 3  Allow me, and I also will speak. After I have spoken, mock on.

p.src: 4  As for me, is my complaint to man? Why shouldn’t I be impatient?

ja: けたものか。 どうして
が気短にならないでおられようか。
en: As for me, is my complaint to man? Why shouldn’t I be impatient?
u.src: 4  As for me, is my complaint to man? Why shouldn’t I be impatient?

p.src: 5  Look at me, and be astonished. Lay your hand on your mouth.

ja: け。 あなたがたの口に
en: Look at me, and be astonished. Lay your hand on your mouth.
u.src: 5  Look at me, and be astonished. Lay your hand on your mouth.

p.src: 6  When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.

ja: こすだけで、私はおののき、
en: When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.
u.src: 6  When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.

p.src: 7  “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?

en: “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?
u.src: 7  “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?

p.src: 8  Their child is established with them in their sight, their offspring before their eyes.

en: Their child is established with them in their sight, their offspring before their eyes.
u.src: 8  Their child is established with them in their sight, their offspring before their eyes.

p.src: 9  Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.

en: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.
u.src: 9  Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.

p.src: 10  Their bulls breed without fail. Their cows calve, and don’t miscarry.

en: Their bulls breed without fail. Their cows calve, and don’t miscarry.
u.src: 10  Their bulls breed without fail. Their cows calve, and don’t miscarry.

p.src: 11  They send out their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.

en: They send out their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.
u.src: 11  They send out their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.

p.src: 12  They sing to the tambourine and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.

en: They sing to the tambourine and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.
u.src: 12  They sing to the tambourine and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.

p.src: 13  They spend their days in prosperity. In an instant they go down to Sheol.

ja: ごす。 そして、一瞬のうちによみ に
en: They spend their days in prosperity. In an instant they go down to Sheol.
u.src: 13  They spend their days in prosperity. In an instant they go down to Sheol.

ja: 21:13 よみ（シェオル）は死者の場所である。
en: 21:13 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 14  They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.

ja: れよ。 私たちはあなたの
en: They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.
u.src: 14  They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.

p.src: 15  What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’

ja: えなければならないのか。 私たちが
en: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’
u.src: 15  What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’

p.src: 16  Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me.

en: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me.
u.src: 16  Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me.

p.src: 17  “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes sorrows in his anger?

ja: えることが、どれほどあるか。
en: “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes sorrows in his anger?
u.src: 17  “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes sorrows in his anger?

p.src: 18  How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind, as chaff that the storm carries away?

ja: のようになることが、どれほどあるだろうか。
en: How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind, as chaff that the storm carries away?
u.src: 18  How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind, as chaff that the storm carries away?

p.src: 19  You say, ‘God lays up his iniquity for his children.’ Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.

ja: えておられる』と。 その人自身に報いて、
en: You say, ‘God lays up his iniquity for his children.’ Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.
u.src: 19  You say, ‘God lays up his iniquity for his children.’ Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.

p.src: 20  Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

en: Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
u.src: 20  Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

p.src: 21  For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?

ja: ち切られた後、 家がどうなろうと、彼に何の関わりがあるのか。
en: For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?
u.src: 21  For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?

p.src: 22  “Shall any teach God knowledge, since he judges those who are high?

ja: 神は高い所にある者たちを裁かれるのに、 誰が
en: “Shall any teach God knowledge, since he judges those who are high?
u.src: 22  “Shall any teach God knowledge, since he judges those who are high?

p.src: 23  One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.

en: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.
u.src: 23  One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.

p.src: 24  His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.

en: His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.
u.src: 24  His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.

p.src: 25  Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.

ja: に、 決して良いものを
en: Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.
u.src: 25  Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.

p.src: 26  They lie down alike in the dust. The worm covers them.

en: They lie down alike in the dust. The worm covers them.
u.src: 26  They lie down alike in the dust. The worm covers them.

p.src: 27  “Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me.

ja: はあなたがたの考えを
っている。 私を責めようとするたくらみを。
en: “Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me.
u.src: 27  “Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me.

p.src: 28  For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’

en: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’
u.src: 28  For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’

p.src: 29  Haven’t you asked wayfaring men? Don’t you know their evidences,

ja: ねなかったのか。 あなたがたは
en: Haven’t you asked wayfaring men? Don’t you know their evidences,
u.src: 29  Haven’t you asked wayfaring men? Don’t you know their evidences,

p.src: 30  that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, that they are led out to the day of wrath?

en: that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, that they are led out to the day of wrath?
u.src: 30  that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, that they are led out to the day of wrath?

p.src: 31  Who will declare his way to his face? Who will repay him what he has done?

ja: げるだろうか。 彼が行ったことを誰が彼に
en: Who will declare his way to his face? Who will repay him what he has done?
u.src: 31  Who will declare his way to his face? Who will repay him what he has done?

p.src: 32  Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men will keep watch over the tomb.

en: Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men will keep watch over the tomb.
u.src: 32  Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men will keep watch over the tomb.

p.src: 33  The clods of the valley will be sweet to him. All men will draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.

ja: き、 彼より前にも数え切れないほどいたように。
en: The clods of the valley will be sweet to him. All men will draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.
u.src: 33  The clods of the valley will be sweet to him. All men will draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.

p.src: 34  So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”

ja: それなら、どうしてあなたがたは無意味なことで
めようとするのか。 あなたがたの
en: So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”
u.src: 34  So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”
